skill.name: Apply responsive image sizing with aspect ratio preservation
skill.description: Use CSS width: 100% and height: auto on img elements within containers, combined with HTML width/height attributes, to maintain aspect ratio across responsive layouts without layout shift.
skill.skill_body: Set width and height attributes on the img element in HTML (e.g., width="640" height="360"). Then apply CSS rule: img { width: 100%; height: auto; }. This allows the browser to calculate aspect ratio from HTML attributes and scale the image to container width while preserving proportions automatically. ## Objective scale images responsively while preserving aspect ratio and preventing cumulative layout shift ## Applicable Signals - image must scale to container width - aspect ratio must remain constant across viewport sizes - layout shift must be avoided during or after image load ## Contraindications - image has fixed pixel dimensions that should not scale - aspect ratio is not uniform across srcset variants - image is not within a sized container ## Intervention Moves - declare width and height attributes on img element - apply CSS width: 100% to scale to container - apply CSS height: auto to preserve aspect ratio ## Workflow Steps - {'step': 1, 'action': 'Set HTML width and height attributes on img element', 'detail': 'Use actual image dimensions or a proportional equivalent (e.g., width="640" height="360" for 16:9 aspect ratio)'} - {'step': 2, 'action': 'Apply CSS rule to img selector', 'detail': 'Set width: 100% to scale to container; set height: auto to let aspect ratio calculate height'} - {'step': 3, 'action': 'Verify aspect ratio is preserved', 'detail': 'Check browser DevTools; aspect-ratio should be computed from HTML attributes (e.g., aspect-ratio: auto 640 / 360)'} ## Constraints - each image in srcset must use the same aspect ratio - container must have a defined width for responsive scaling to work ## Cautions - if srcset images have different aspect ratios, layout shift may still occur; ensure all variants match ## Output Contract - Image scales to container width - height adjusts automatically via aspect-ratio calculation - no layout shift occurs during or after image load - responsive scaling works across viewport sizes ## Example Executions ### Example 1 - Input: HTML: ; CSS: img { width: 100%; height: auto; } - Output: Image displays at container width with 16:9 aspect ratio maintained; height calculated automatically; no CLS - Notes: Aspect ratio is computed by browser from HTML attributes before image loads
